comment:
* Abstract class that forwards touch events to a {@link ShowableListMenu}.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: mScaledTouchSlop
variables.comment: Scaled touch slop, used for detecting movement outside bounds.

variables.name: mTapTimeout
variables.comment: Timeout before disallowing intercept on the source's parent.

variables.name: mLongPressTimeout
variables.comment: Timeout before accepting a long-press to start forwarding.

variables.name: mSrc
variables.comment: Source view from which events are forwarded.

variables.name: mDisallowIntercept
variables.comment: Runnable used to prevent conflicts with scrolling parents.

variables.name: mTriggerLongPress
variables.comment: Runnable used to trigger forwarding on long-press.

variables.name: mForwarding
variables.comment: Whether this listener is currently forwarding touch events.

variables.name: mActivePointerId
variables.comment: The id of the first pointer down in the current event stream.

methods.name: public abstract ShowableListMenu getPopup()
methods.comment:
* Returns the popup to which this listener is forwarding events. *

* Override this to return the correct popup. If the popup is displayed * asynchronously, you may also need to override * {@link #onForwardingStopped} to prevent premature cancelation of * forwarding. * * @return the popup to which this listener is forwarding events

methods.name: public boolean onTouch(View v, MotionEvent event)
protected boolean onForwardingStarted()
methods.comment:
* Called when forwarding would like to start. *

* By default, this will show the popup returned by {@link #getPopup()}. * It may be overridden to perform another action, like clicking the * source view or preparing the popup before showing it. * * @return true to start forwarding, false otherwise

methods.name: protected boolean onForwardingStopped()
methods.comment:
* Called when forwarding would like to stop. *

* By default, this will dismiss the popup returned by * {@link #getPopup()}. It may be overridden to perform some other * action. * * @return true to stop forwarding, false otherwise

methods.name: private boolean onTouchObserved(MotionEvent srcEvent)
methods.comment:
* Observes motion events and determines when to start forwarding.
     *
     * @param srcEvent motion event in source view coordinates
     * @return true to start forwarding motion events, false otherwise

methods.name: private boolean onTouchForwarded(MotionEvent srcEvent)
methods.comment:
* Handles forwarded motion events and determines when to stop
     * forwarding.
     *
     * @param srcEvent motion event in source view coordinates
     * @return true to continue forwarding motion events, false to cancel

methods.name: private static boolean pointInView(View view, float localX, float localY, float slop)
private boolean toLocalMotionEvent(View view, MotionEvent event)
methods.comment:
* Emulates View.toLocalMotionEvent(). This implementation does not handle transformations
     * (scaleX, scaleY, etc).

methods.name: private boolean toGlobalMotionEvent(View view, MotionEvent event)
methods.comment:
* Emulates View.toGlobalMotionEvent(). This implementation does not handle transformations
     * (scaleX, scaleY, etc).
